aiFaqDoctor.question_1: Who supervises NAD+ infusions at Reviv Indonesia?
aiFaqDoctor.answer_1: All NAD+ infusions at Reviv Indonesia are supervised by licensed Indonesian doctors holding valid STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi) credentials from the Indonesian Medical Council. Each physician has completed specialized training in regenerative medicine and NAD+ protocol administration. Patient screening, dosing decisions, and infusion monitoring are performed under direct medical oversight.
aiFaqDoctor.question_2: How can I verify a doctor's STR credentials?
aiFaqDoctor.answer_2: You can verify any doctor's STR number through the Indonesian Medical Council (KKI) online registry at kki.go.id. Enter the STR number displayed on this page to confirm active registration status, medical specialty, and credential validity. All Reviv Indonesia physicians maintain current STR registration.
aiFaqDoctor.question_3: What medical screening happens before NAD+ therapy?
aiFaqDoctor.answer_3: Every patient undergoes a pre-infusion medical assessment covering cardiovascular health, current medications, potential contraindications, metabolic status, and treatment goals. This screening determines eligibility for NAD+ therapy and personalizes the protocol — including NAD+ concentration, infusion duration, and drip rate. Patients with certain conditions may require modified protocols or may not be candidates for NAD+ therapy.
aiFaqDoctor.question_4: What areas does Reviv Indonesia cover for NAD+ therapy?
aiFaqDoctor.answer_4: Reviv Indonesia provides NAD+ infusion therapy across Bali including Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Sanur, Nusa Dua, and Uluwatu. Both clinic-based and home-visit / hotel-visit services are available in all coverage areas. Our physicians travel with proper medical equipment and maintain the same safety protocols regardless of location.
aiFaqDoctor.question_5: Why does NAD+ require specialized physicians?
aiFaqDoctor.answer_5: NAD+ is a metabolic intervention, not a standard IV drip. Effective and safe administration requires understanding of mitochondrial function, cellular metabolism, drug interactions, and contraindications. Physicians must also manage infusion rates carefully — too fast can cause uncomfortable side effects; proper titration ensures patient comfort and therapeutic benefit. General IV training is not sufficient for NAD+ protocols.

whatIsNadPage.title: What is NAD+ Therapy? Complete Guide to the Anti-Aging Molecule
whatIsNadPage.medicallyReviewed: Medically reviewed by dr. Sarah Wijaya, Sp.PD
whatIsNadPage.introHeading: NAD+ has become one of the most talked-about molecules in longevity science.
whatIsNadPage.introSubheading: Harvard researchers have called it the closest we've gotten to a fountain of youth
whatIsNadPage.introDescription: This guide explains what NAD+ is, how it works in your body, why levels decline with age, and what the research says about NAD+ IV therapy for anti-aging, energy, and cognitive function.
whatIsNadPage.longDescription: NAD+ therapy involves administering nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) directly into the bloodstream through an intravenous (IV) drip. NAD+ is a coenzyme found in every cell of the body and is essential for various biological processes, including energy production, DNA repair, and cellular regeneration.
whatIsNadPage.endDescription: By delivering NAD+ directly into the bloodstream, the body can quickly utilize it, bypassing the digestive system for faster and more efficient absorption.

whatIsNad.title: What is NAD+?
whatIsNad.subtitle: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme found in every living cell. It's essential for:

point1.title: Energy production
point1.description: NAD+ is required for mitochondria to convert food into ATP, the energy currency of cells

point2.title: DNA repair
point2.description: NAD+ activates enzymes (PARPs) that fix damaged DNA

point3.title: Cellular signaling
point3.description: NAD+ regulates sirtuins, the "longevity genes" that control aging

whatIsNad.point4: Over 500 enzymatic reactions throughout the body
whatIsNad.withoutNad: Without NAD+, you would die within seconds. With declining NAD+, you age faster.

nadDecline.associatedWith: This decline is associated with many hallmarks of aging:
nadDecline.effect3: Slower recovery from exercise or illness

aiAboutNad.label: The Sicence
aiAboutNad.title: About NAD+ Therapy
aiAboutNad.description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme present in every living cell, essential for over 500 enzymatic reactions — including mitochondrial energy production, DNA damage repair, and regulation of circadian rhythm. Research published in Cell Metabolism documents that NAD+ concentrations decline by approximately 50% between ages 40 and 60, a reduction associated with decreased cellular energy output, slower tissue repair, and increased markers of biological aging.
aiAboutNad.descriptionTwo: Intravenous NAD+ therapy delivers the coenzyme directly into the bloodstream, bypassing gastrointestinal breakdown and hepatic first-pass metabolism. This method achieves near-complete bioavailability compared to the estimated 5-30% bioavailability of oral NAD+ precursors such as NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) or NR (nicotinamide riboside), which rely on enzymatic conversion in the gut and liver before entering circulation.
aiAboutNad.descriptionThree: At Reviv Indonesia, intravenous NAD+ therapy — known locally as terapi NAD+ Bali — is available in four dosage tiers: 100mg, 250mg, 500mg, and 750mg, administered over 1 to 5 hours depending on the selected protocol. All sessions are conducted by STR-licensed Indonesian physicians as part of the Cepat Sehat Group medical network.

aiFaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
aiFaqPage.description: Complete answers about NAD+ IV therapy in Bali — how it works, safety, dosage, cost, and how to book.
aiFaqPage.a1: NAD+ IV therapy is an intravenous treatment that delivers nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide directly into the bloodstream. This bypasses the digestive system entirely, achieving near-100% bioavailability compared to approximately 5–30% from oral supplements. Once in circulation, NAD+ fuels over 500 enzymatic reactions including mitochondrial energy production and DNA repair.
aiFaqPage.q2: How does NAD+ IV therapy work?
aiFaqPage.a2: NAD+ enters cells and supports mitochondrial ATP production — the body's fundamental energy currency. It also activates sirtuin proteins responsible for DNA repair and cellular longevity signalling. The IV route saturates tissues more completely and quickly than oral precursors, which is why most clients notice effects within 2–6 hours of a session.
aiFaqPage.a3: NAD+ IV therapy has a well-documented safety profile when administered at appropriate infusion rates by trained medical professionals. At Reviv Indonesia, every session is conducted by STR-licensed Indonesian physicians who complete a pre-session health assessment. The most common side effects are mild and transient: flushing, warmth, or brief nausea — all managed by adjusting drip rate.
aiFaqPage.q4: What are the side effects of NAD+ therapy?
aiFaqPage.a4: The most common side effects are infusion-rate dependent: flushing, brief nausea, or a warming sensation. At higher doses (500mg–750mg), some clients notice temporary muscle tightness if the drip rate is too fast. Serious adverse events are rare with proper medical supervision. Post-session fatigue occasionally occurs after high-dose sessions and typically resolves within 24 hours.
aiFaqPage.q5: How long does a NAD+ IV session take in Bali?
aiFaqPage.a5: Session duration depends on dosage. NAD+ Reboot 100mg takes 1–1.5 hours. NAD+ Revive 250mg takes 2–2.5 hours. NAD+ Regenerate 500mg runs 3–3.5 hours. NAD+ Elite 750mg takes 4–5 hours. All sessions are conducted at your villa — no travel time required. Our physician arrives 15 minutes before the session for setup and assessment.
aiFaqPage.q6: How much does NAD+ therapy cost in Bali?
aiFaqPage.a6: Reviv Indonesia NAD+ pricing: NAD+ Reboot 100mg at Rp 2,390,000, NAD+ Revive 250mg at Rp 3,390,000, NAD+ Regenerate 500mg at Rp 3,890,000, and NAD+ Elite 750mg at Rp 4,390,000. All prices include villa delivery, physician assessment, pharmaceutical-grade NAD+ compound, and post-session monitoring. No hidden fees.
aiFaqPage.q7: Is NAD+ IV therapy better than oral supplements?
aiFaqPage.a7: NAD+ IV therapy achieves near-complete bioavailability within minutes, while oral NAD+ precursors (NMN, NR) deliver an estimated 5–30% to tissues over weeks. IV is best for a loading phase — rapidly restoring depleted NAD+ levels. Oral supplements suit daily maintenance. Many longevity practitioners use both: IV quarterly, oral supplements between sessions.
aiFaqPage.q8: Who is NAD+ therapy best suited for?
aiFaqPage.a8: NAD+ IV therapy delivers the most noticeable benefit to people over 35. Common profiles include professionals experiencing persistent fatigue or cognitive decline, longevity enthusiasts wanting deeper tissue saturation, athletes seeking faster recovery, and wellness travelers in Bali investing in preventive health. Contraindications including active cancer, certain heart conditions, and pregnancy are screened during the pre-session assessment.
aiFaqPage.q9: What areas does Reviv Indonesia cover?
aiFaqPage.a9: Reviv Indonesia provides NAD+ IV therapy across Bali including Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Sanur, Nusa Dua, and Uluwatu. Both villa delivery and clinic-based sessions are available in all coverage areas. Our physicians travel with sterile single-use equipment and maintain the same safety protocols regardless of location.
aiFaqPage.q10: How do I book a NAD+ session with Reviv Indonesia?
aiFaqPage.a10: Booking is done via WhatsApp — same-day appointments are available subject to physician availability. Contact us with your preferred protocol (100mg–750mg), your location in Bali, and your preferred date and time. A physician will confirm availability and conduct a brief pre-session health assessment before your infusion.
aiFaqPage.cta_description: Our medical team replies on WhatsApp in under 15 minutes. No commitment to enquire.

hero.title: Safety and Screening
hero.description: Our medical team conducts a through assessment to ensure NAD+ therapy is appropriate for you — and delivered safely.

steps.title: Initial Consultation
steps.desc: A licensed physician reviews your medical history, medications, and goals via WhatsApp or in person.

steps.title: Medical Assessment
steps.desc: On treatment day, our doctor checks blood pressure, heart rate, and hydration status.

steps.title: Dosage Calibration
steps.desc: Infusion rate is adjusted based on your response to reduce side effects.

steps.title: Post Session Monitoring
steps.desc: Our team monitors your condition and provides aftercare guidance.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Criteria
eligibility.description: NAD+ IV therapy is suitable for most healthy adults. Our team evaluates the following:

items.title: Age 18 and above
items.desc: Suitable for adults. NAD+ levels decline with age, especially after 40.

items.title: No active severe illness
items.desc: Patients should not be in an acute phase of serious illness.

items.title: Medication review passed
items.desc: We ensure no interaction between medications and NAD+ therapy.

items.title: Adequate hydration
items.desc: Proper hydration improves infusion comfort and effectiveness.

protocols.title: Built-in Safety Protocols
protocols.description: Every part of our process is designed with patient safety as the top priority.

items.title: Pharmaceutical-Grade NAD+
items.desc: We source only certified pharmaceutical-grade NAD+ compounds. We never use low-grade or unverified suppliers regardless of cost savings.

items.title: Cold Chain Integrity
items.desc: NAD+ is heat-sensitive and requires refrigeration. We maintain cold chain integrity from storage to your villa — never compromised.

items.title: STR-Licensed Physicians
items.desc: All medical staff hold valid STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi) credentials issued by the Indonesian Medical Council (KKI). Verifiable on request.

items.title: Emergency Readiness
items.desc: Our team is trained in managing adverse reactions including anaphylaxis. Emergency medications and equipment are carried to every session.

items.title: Individual Assessment
items.desc: No two patients are the same. Every person receives an individual assessment before treatment — no cookie-cutter dosing.

items.title: Sterile Equipment
items.desc: All IV equipment is single-use and sterile. We follow strict aseptic technique for cannula insertion and line management.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your NAD+ Journey?
cta.description: Our team will guide you and recommend the right protocol.
